scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present run test && pnpm run test:release-certification && pnpm run test:security && pnpm run test:infra && pnpm run test:sdk-python && pnpm run test:sdk-java
scripts.test:infra: node --test tools/postgres-migrate.test.mjs tools/kubernetes-production.test.mjs tools/factory-status.test.mjs tools/repository-baseline.test.mjs tools/repository-architecture.test.mjs tools/local-seed.test.mjs tools/production-surface-gate.test.mjs tools/backup-drill.test.mjs tools/seedream-launch-check.test.mjs
scripts.test:sdk-python: PYTHONPATH=packages/sdk-python/src python3 -W error -m unittest discover -s packages/sdk-python/tests -v
scripts.test:timecapsule: python3 spec/timecapsule/tests/validate_package.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s spec/timecapsule/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s services/timecapsule/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:a11y
scripts.dev: APP_ENV=local LTM_AUTH_MODE=local-synthetic-only LTM_ALLOW_LEGACY_CONSENT_POLICY=true PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @ltm/api run dev
scripts.start:local: APP_ENV=local LTM_AUTH_MODE=local-synthetic-only LTM_ALLOW_LEGACY_CONSENT_POLICY=true PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @ltm/api run start
